SELECT cr.room_id, cr.room_type, CASE cr.room_type WHEN 'industry' THEN i.name WHEN 'region' THEN r.name WHEN 'loan' THEN l.product_name WHEN 'policy' THEN p.policy_name END AS name FROM chat_rooms cr LEFT JOIN industry i ON cr.industry_id = i.industry_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON cr.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN loans l ON cr.loan_id = l.loan_id LEFT JOIN policies p ON cr.policy_id = p.policy_id
cr.room_type = #{type}
